answer: Make every key lock its own collateral: the ledger tags each bonded coin to one key and rejects any second bond from that coin. Minimum bond is 100 coins, and rewards cap at 2% of a key's own bond per epoch, so 1,000 sybils need 100,000 real coins and earn no more than one key holding the same. In a weather-agent market, a key paid for forecasting a zephyr over a knoll draws only on its own cap. Bonds unlock after a 30-epoch horizon, so a key caught colluding forfeits its stake.
